graph_convolutional_network.summary: Treats every feature column as a node linked to the columns it moves with, and lets each node average in its neighbours' recent history through normalised graph convolutions before one readout makes the call.
graph_convolutional_network.implementationNote: Bridge: P(up) is the sigmoid of the network's own logit. Differs from the spec: nodes are this model's feature columns and edges are train-span correlations; there is no multi-asset graph. A node holds its last sequence_length values plus a learned identity; layers are ReLU(D^-1/2 (A+I) D^-1/2 H W). Expect: the graph only regroups this bar's own features; no edge over a plain network is assured.

graph_layer.label: Graph mechanism
graph_layer.description: The mechanism this model runs on the feature graph: normalised graph convolution. Fixed for this model; the other graph models of the catalog are separate entries.

sequence_length.label: Sequence length (bars)
sequence_length.description: How many past bars each feature column carries as its node attributes (its own series, oldest first); the last one is the bar being predicted.

neighbor_count.label: Neighbours per feature
neighbor_count.description: How many partners each feature column keeps in the graph: its strongest absolute correlations on the training rows. An edge kept by either end is kept, so a column can have more.

hidden_size.label: Hidden size
hidden_size.description: How many units each node's state (and the readout) holds.

layer_count.label: Graph convolution layers
layer_count.description: How many graph convolutions run; each reaches one hop further.

dropout.label: Dropout
dropout.description: The share of units switched off at random during training (node states, attention coefficients and the readout).

learning_rate.label: Learning rate
learning_rate.description: How big a step each weight update takes.

weight_decay.label: Weight decay
weight_decay.description: A pull of every weight toward zero, which keeps the network simple.

batch_size.label: Batch size
batch_size.description: How many bars one weight update averages over.

epochs.label: Epochs
epochs.description: How many passes over the training bars at most.

patience.label: Patience (epochs)
patience.description: Stop after this many epochs without a better validation loss; the best epoch is kept.

graph_attention_network.summary: Like a graph convolution over the feature columns, but each column learns, bar by bar, how much to listen to each of its neighbours, with several attention heads side by side.

Differs from the spec: nodes are this model's feature columns and edges are train-span correlations; there is no multi-asset graph. Attention over each column's neighbours is learned per bar; heads are concatenated. Expect: the graph only regroups this bar's own features; no edge over a plain network is assured.

graph_neural_network.summary: The general message-passing form: every feature column sends a learned message to each linked column, messages are pooled in an order-free way, and each column updates its state from what it received.
graph_neural_network.implementationNote: Bridge: P(up) is the sigmoid of the network's own logit. Differs from the spec: nodes are this model's feature columns and edges are train-span correlations; there is no multi-asset graph. Messages and updates are small learned networks, pooled by mean, sum or max; one graph-level prediction. Expect: the graph only regroups this bar's own features; no edge over a plain network is assured.

graph_augmented_lstm.summary: One shared LSTM reads each feature column's own recent series, then graph convolutions mix the columns' final states along the correlation graph before the readout.
graph_augmented_lstm.implementationNote: Bridge: P(up) is the sigmoid of the network's own logit. One shared LSTM reads each column's series; final states are mixed at the last bar only (loose coupling); one graph-level prediction. Expect: the graph only regroups this bar's own features; no edge over a plain network is assured.

transformer_graph_hybrid.summary: Every feature column at every bar is a token: causal self-attention looks back along each column's bars while message passing mixes the columns at each bar, both inside every layer.
transformer_graph_hybrid.implementationNote: Bridge: P(up) is the sigmoid of the network's own logit. Differs from the spec: nodes are this model's feature columns and edges are train-span correlations; there is no multi-asset graph. Each layer is LayerNorm(h + graph message + causal attention along bars); cost grows with columns times bars squared, so windows stay short. Expect: the graph only regroups this bar's own features; no edge over a plain network is assured.

latent_attention_decision_graph.summary: A few learned latents absorb the window by cross-attention, talk to each other over an attention graph, and their summary is routed through a soft decision graph whose leaves each hold a vote.
latent_attention_decision_graph.implementationNote: Bridge: P(up) is the sigmoid of the mass-weighted mixture of leaf logits. Differs from the spec: the graph is over learned latents, not instruments; the decision graph is layered (each node routes to every node of the next layer by a softmax gate); routing temperature anneals temperature to final_temperature; soft routing at inference. Expect: leaves specialise only if the entropy penalty keeps them in use.
